title: AeroGarden or Click & Grow? Pick in 30 Seconds #Shorts
description: AeroGarden or Click & Grow for a small apartment? Choose based on capacity, noise, and counter space.

slides.headline:
AeroGarden
or Click & Grow?
slides.subhead: Pick the right countertop garden in 30 seconds.
slides.narration: AeroGarden or Click and Grow? For a small apartment, the answer comes down to two things: how many herbs you want, and how much noise you can tolerate.

slides.headline:
More herbs.
Bigger harvest.
slides.subhead: Six-pod capacity beats three when you cook with herbs every week.
slides.narration: Choose AeroGarden if you cook with herbs every week. The six-pod Harvest class gives you more useful growing capacity.

slides.headline:
Silent.
Narrower footprint.
slides.subhead: The passive wick system fits studios and shared rooms.
slides.narration: Choose Click and Grow if silence matters most. Its passive wick system has no pump hum, and the unit fits narrower counters.

slides.headline:
Refill pods
add up.
slides.subhead: Learn with one branded cycle, then consider blank inserts and your own seeds.
slides.narration: The catch? Refill pods add up for both brands. Learn with one branded cycle, then consider blank inserts and seeds you actually use.

slides.headline:
Capacity?
AeroGarden.
slides.subhead: Absolute quiet? Click & Grow. Full comparison at sillgarden.com.
slides.narration: The verdict: choose AeroGarden for capacity, or Click and Grow for absolute quiet. The full comparison is linked below.
